method: Every league edition is split by date. The earlier share of each season fits each contender, the remaining matches are predicted, and no contender sees a match it was fitted on. Reported figures are 1X2 log loss, Brier score and top-pick accuracy, pooled over editions.
caveats: This measures ordinary league fixtures, which is not what the simulator is for: cross-era matchups have no ground truth and are not evaluated here, and never can be from this data.
Tactical approaches, formations and venue beyond home advantage are not part of this test.
A fitted alternative was tried and lost; the engine was left as it is rather than replaced.
